quarterly_data.quarter: Yangtze Memory Technologies press release: release 65 (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: YMTC's consumer SSD brand ZhiTai put the ZhiTai TiPro9000 SSD x Fubuki co-branded edition (with the ASUS ROG STRIX Fubuki series; ZhiTai calls itself an ASUS ecosystem partner) on sale on October 20, 2026. It uses YMTC's new-generation Xtacking 4.0 architecture flash, with sequential read up to 14900 MB/s, sequential write up to 13800 MB/s and 4K random read / write up to 2100K / 2200K IOPS, in 1TB and 2TB capacities, sold through ZhiTai's JD.com self-operated flagship store.
quarterly_data.figure: sequential read up to 14900 MB/s; sequential write up to 13800 MB/s
